messages:
taylor: Quick sync — ACME legal pushed again: pilot must include tenant-level routing + SSO handshake. Sales says it's a make-or-break for the pilot contract.

hema: That is... tight. We planned SSO for v1. What's the minimal SSO we can actually ship safely in the pilot?

devon: Minimal = SAML assertion flow + one-time metadata exchange + scoped claim mapping. No admin UI, no IdP discovery. Backcompat with our cert rotation model.

mika: Tenant routing can be scoped too: route by tenant header only (no fancy routing rules). Ops: anything blocking?

ops-bot: @product flagged: tenant header routing requires per-tenant config store entries + small LB rule. Infra estimate: 2 infra-days, 1 oncall prep. KMS impact: low if we use existing key store; else +1 dev-day.

hema: Tradeoffs: moving these to pilot increases verification work (SAST + security sign-off). That could slip our QA window. Can we create an "MVP carve" plan to keep public MVP unchanged?

taylor: Proposal: create a pilot-only feature-flagged carve. Public MVP = unchanged. Pilot carve = minimal SSO + header-routing. We run ACME on a feature-flagged slab for 2 weeks.

devon: I like carve idea. Needs three controls: feature flag gate, canary traffic (5%), and fast rollback plan. Also add smoke tests for SSO handshake.

mika: Action items: (1) Devon to write minimal SSO acceptance criteria with test vectors (due Thu COB). (2) Ops to open infra tickets with milestone tag MLP-43 (due Wed). (3) Product to draft pilot scope doc and customer-visible checklist (Taylor/Hema, due Mon). (4) Sales to confirm ACME pilot expectations in writing (Sales-bot to ping).

sales-bot: @sales: ACME asked for demo slide + pilot checklist by next Tue. Tagging account exec.

hema: Also let's call out explicit cut candidates if we need time: defer promptstore UI, advanced billing metrics, and role-based admin settings. Those are safe to move to v1.

taylor: Add note: any SSO telemetry should be tagged so we can monitor error bursts. Set alert if SSO failure rate > 1% over 5m.

devon: Will add alerts + a tiny health endpoint for SAML handshake latency.

ops-bot: Reminder: include runbook steps for key rotation and emergency disable of routing header.

mika: Timeline impact: baseline public MVP ship 2024-03-31. Pilot carve path doesn't change public date but shifts some QA cycles earlier — pilot start targeted 2024-03-18. If we can't get infra & security signoff by 3/15, we fallback to v1 delivery for SSO in public roadmap.

taylor: Consensus check? quick emoji? :white_check_mark: :no_entry: etc.

hema: +1 from product. Keep the carve surgical.

devon: +1 eng. I'll drop the acceptance doc in #docs and link back here.

sales-bot: ACME PM confirms they can accept minimal SSO for pilot if we document known gaps.

ops-bot: Final note: add tickets to milestone MLP-43 and tag security review SR-19.
